decision: Permit this external collector for explicitly scoped DRM memory endpoint observations. Do not infer complete lifetime, peak or residency acceptance.

method_review.finding: Initial drm-total prefix incorrectly treated drm-total-cycles utilization as bytes. Corrected by excluding that namespace; retained raw counters and added utilization-only negative in the single controls batch.
method_review.scope: Source/method review, not independent native replay.

limits: Only explicitly supplied PIDs and listed descriptors are observed. Open/close between reads, omitted descendants and lifecycle epochs remain unresolved; no automatic lifetime integration.
complete_enumeration means listed reads succeeded with identified clients. It does not prove an atomic snapshot or lifetime completeness. Errors and unidentified clients retain partial observations.
memory_counters_available means at least some memory fields for each identified client, not complete residency coverage. Empty or absent counters are unknown; explicit zero is preserved.
Separate memory classes may overlap; aliases are grouped, never summed. Deprecated drm-memory is retained separately from resident. Samples are sequential, not instantaneous peaks.
A client absent at an endpoint does not establish zero driver retention. ACC-03 start/end and reset/epoch receipts remain required.
No Datum process launched, GPU workload repeated, Cargo build performed, observer overhead qualified or numerical acceptance claimed. Final packet candidate remains historical and NOT READY.

endurance_integration.status: Prepared and source-reviewed; not executed natively
endurance_integration.ordering: Driver reads precede final CPU readings and observation_end_ns, then acknowledgement releases the held device. Historical monotonic_ns remains pre-CPU; observation_begin_ns/end_ns bracket sequential reads.
endurance_integration.failure: Missing or unidentified clients, read errors or no resident fields fail the endpoint. Already collected driver records enter the report before CPU reads; failed partial rows may lack CPU or end timestamps. Existing failure preservation/cleanup remains in force.
endurance_integration.review: Hegel identified partial-record loss on subsequent CPU failure and timestamp compatibility risk. Partial data is now appended before CPU reads; historical timestamp semantics restored using a separate end field. Source review only.
endurance_integration.verification: Runner syntax compiled without executing top-level native setup. Existing collector controls reused; no repeated parser tests, application build or endurance run.
endurance_integration.limits: Resident fields cover identified observed clients only. This does not prove all relevant clients export fdinfo, capture earlier exits/startup, establish lifecycle epochs, quantify overhead, or satisfy complete ACC-01/03. Historical source/binary pins still prevent an unpinned run; refresh the stable final candidate before replay.
